title: InventionSettings
description: Data file content/invention/settings.json (D471 D5, B4b): when an inhabitant wants to invent something, what the core sends to the AI and the limits of its final check. Placeholders until Marcel decides; no invention, recipe or object is named here.

job_priority.description: Priority of invention jobs in the service queue (B7 O2).

retry_after_minutes.description: After a retryable error the wish stays open and is sent again with a new request id after this many game minutes (B2487).

tech_level.description: Highest tech level the world allows now (vocabulary tech_level; order of the vocabulary = order of the levels).

forbidden_terms.description: Youth protection for inventions (B4b R16, B2481): what an invention, a new need or a new ability must not be - a weapon, a trap, hunting or fishing gear, poison. A name holding one of these terms is refused by the core whatever the AI guard said (reason forbidden_purpose). Per language; a term matches a whole word, * at its start lets the word begin otherwise (German compounds: *falle matches Tierfalle), * at its end lets it go on (jagd* matches Jagdspeer). Kept apart from the content guard of all AI text, so a thought may still name a spear. Omitted = no such check.

max_materials.description: At most this many perceived things are sent as materials (contract maximum 16).

require_base_function.description: Final check point 11 (D827 R31): when true, an invention without a base function is refused (missing_base_function). False while the guard does not map things yet; a base function that is not in the list is always refused.

implied_properties.description: Properties every runtime type from an invention has besides its own introduces (e.g. that inhabitants made it, so the routine layer can offer to use it).

living_properties.description: B2531: properties only living beings have. An invention that brings one of them is refused by the core. Empty while the property vocabulary has none.

InventionTrigger.description: A lack without a solution: a need stays below a threshold for a while (D471 stage 1).

need_below.description: Need satisfaction below this counts as lack (0 = unsatisfied, 1 = satisfied).

hours_below.description: Game hours the need must stay below the threshold.

cooldown_hours.description: Game hours before the same inhabitant wants to invent again after a wish closed.

max_open.description: Open wishes in the whole world at the same time.

idea_ripe_at.description: B2687 (B4b R28, A1585): an own idea whose strength reached this value and whose roots the inhabitant still believes becomes a wish (trigger 'idea') when no lack does; once per idea, with the same cooldown and open limit. Absent = ideas never become wishes.

InventionLimitSettings.description: Limits sent with every invention job and checked again by the core (B4b R14).
